nodes.label: After Ho Chi Minh
nodes.description: Ho Chi Minh's death has left the revolution with a shared legacy and several centres of authority. Le Duan, President Ton Duc Thang and Prime Minister Pham Van Dong must hold the institutions together through another difficult year.
nodes.reason: A functioning secretariat reduces administration costs immediately and opens actual political consultations.

nodes.label: Fund Reserve Training Networks
nodes.description: Assign the next extraordinary cadre, salary and transport allocation to district reserve instructors. Local mobilisation will be better prepared, while provincial civilian offices must wait for their own expansion programme.
nodes.reason: The next extraordinary cadre budget pays for a trained reserve network and wartime cohesion.

nodes.label: Fund Provincial Civil Offices
nodes.description: Assign the next extraordinary cadre, salary and transport allocation to provincial civil offices. Better local records and public services reduce administrative waste, while the reserve training network receives no equivalent expansion from this allocation.
nodes.reason: The same cadre budget can instead fund functioning provincial offices and predictable public services.

nodes.label: Broaden the Front
nodes.description: A broader Front must offer rural representatives a practical role. Establish an advisory compact on farm inputs and local distribution, using their knowledge to improve deliveries while accepting that the Party cannot dictate every recommendation.

lines.text: 4 percentage points of support for the Front

nodes.reason: A rural advisory compact brings cooperative administrators and local producers into practical input and distribution planning.

nodes.label: National Sovereignty
nodes.description: Sovereignty must be supported by the ability to keep workshops and defensive units supplied. Establish domestic spare part stocks, repair arrangements and alternative procurement contacts, accepting the cost of maintaining this independent organisation.

lines.text: 4 percentage points of support for the military council

nodes.reason: Sovereign procurement develops spare-part stocks and repair organisation instead of relying on a declaration of independence.

nodes.label: Professional Cadres
nodes.description: Administrative competence cannot be supplied by revolutionary credentials alone. Train cadres to investigate conditions, keep reliable accounts and deliver public services.
nodes.reason: A professional civil service substantially reduces bureaucracy and improves technical administration.

nodes.label: Mass Organisation
nodes.description: Mass organisations connect the state to villages, factories and neighbourhoods. Deepen that network while accepting the work required to maintain it.
nodes.reason: Mass organisations provide wartime cohesion and an organised reserve network.

nodes.label: Rural Schools
nodes.description: War has displaced teachers and disrupted schooling without extinguishing the ambition to learn. Extend education beyond the better served towns and protect the next generation of technicians.
nodes.reason: Basic rural literacy supports recruit training and improves the national base for further education.

nodes.label: Women in Public Life
nodes.description: Women sustain production, public administration and family life under exceptional pressure. Wider participation must be accompanied by practical support rather than another unpaid obligation.
nodes.reason: Participation by women expands agricultural and workshop labour rather than multiplying a signed growth rate.

nodes.label: National Assembly
nodes.description: The National Assembly can become a more useful channel between policy and the people who live with it. Strengthening its work requires an administration capable of responding.

lines.text: Improve Cadre State to recovery stage 1

before.text: Improve Cadre State to recovery stage 1

nodes.reason: An accountable assembly improves the existing cadre-state spirit and cuts recurring administration.

nodes.label: Cadre Discipline
nodes.description: The cadre service must answer to a common chain of authority. Tighter discipline can improve execution, but it can also discourage honest disagreement.
nodes.reason: Central inspection raises collection from enterprises and makes procurement more reliable.

nodes.label: Public Criticism
nodes.description: Policy failures do not disappear when nobody dares to describe them. Protect criticism that exposes abuse while accepting a more contested political environment.
nodes.reason: Protected criticism exposes failed projects and improves technical problem solving.

nodes.label: Provincial Councils
nodes.description: Provincial authorities know local shortages and productive possibilities better than distant offices. Give their councils a clearer place in the national programme.
nodes.reason: Provincial offices cut duplication and deliver local roads faster.

nodes.label: Freedom of Worship
nodes.description: Buddhist and Catholic communities are part of the nation, not a single political bloc. Negotiate practical protections for religious life and equal treatment before public authorities.
nodes.reason: Religious accommodation improves social stability while reducing costly civic disputes.

nodes.label: A Durable Charter
nodes.description: A durable charter must outlast the ambitions of its authors. Establish institutions that can carry public responsibilities through changes of leadership and government.

lines.text: Improve Cadre State to recovery stage 2

before.text: Improve Cadre State to recovery stage 2

nodes.reason: The charter completes another cadre-state recovery stage and stabilises government beyond one leader.

nodes.label: Southern Priority
nodes.description: Le Duan places the struggle in the South at the centre of national strategy. The North must sustain that effort while living with the demands it makes on reconstruction.
nodes.reason: An organised national war effort provides an immediate fighting and mobilisation dividend.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: General Offensive
nodes.description: Concentrate the next staff, reserve equipment and training allocation on a regular offensive. The main force gains the cohesion needed for a decisive campaign, while its supply commitment grows. Negotiations and local defence continue alongside this priority.
nodes.reason: A player seeking a battlefield breakthrough gets more usable military production, cohesion and experienced staff.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Protracted Pressure
nodes.description: Concentrate the next staff and training allocation on staying power, protected routes and territorial defence. The army can sustain pressure with fewer supply demands, while a rapid offensive receives less planning attention. This course does not close the negotiating channel.
nodes.reason: A player protecting scarce equipment gets an economical defensive army and a cheaper doctrinal adaptation.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: The Main Force
nodes.description: Bring the principal formations and their supporting production into a more concentrated effort. Farms and civilian workshops will feel the diversion of scarce resources.
nodes.reason: Weapons standardisation supports actual rearmament and conversion of the wartime production base.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Fight and Negotiate
nodes.description: Military pressure and negotiation can serve the same strategy. Prepare a diplomatic channel without assuming that the opposing governments will accept our terms.
nodes.reason: A calmer and less wasteful administration can maintain Paris contacts while the war continues.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: The Party Congress
nodes.description: Peace permits a congress to turn from the endurance of war to the shape of the national economy. The ambitions adopted here must still confront limited resources and administrative capacity.
nodes.reason: Better planning coordination raises the speed at which existing production lines reach useful efficiency.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Heavy Industry First
nodes.description: Reserve the next industrial allocation for machine building, armament workshops and the technical knowledge needed to sustain them. More of the scarce capital stays in heavy production, leaving less for immediate agricultural improvement.
nodes.reason: A weapons-producing country gets a materially higher industrial ceiling rather than another political-power coupon.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Balanced Recovery
nodes.description: Direct the next reconstruction allocation towards food production and civilian works. Recovery must be visible in fields and ordinary workshops, even though the same investment cannot simultaneously expand the military production programme.
nodes.reason: Food productivity and a broader reconstruction programme make a long recovery viable.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Industrial Combine
nodes.description: The northeastern industrial base can support a wider range of national production. Organise the planning and construction of a new combine rather than relying indefinitely on imported capacity.

lines.text: Start construction of Civilian complex in state 524

before.text: Start construction of Civilian complex in state 524

nodes.reason: The useful reward is its real queued civilian factory; this catalogue adds no free instant factory or redundant percentage surcharge.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Food and Goods
nodes.description: Food supply and everyday goods determine whether recovery is felt outside the offices of the plan. Direct more of the programme towards those immediate needs.
nodes.reason: The civilian route gains productive food supply and practical local reconstruction capacity.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Integration Policy
nodes.description: The institutions of North and South cannot be joined by a proclamation alone. Where the country has actually been reunited, decide how quickly their administrations and economic arrangements should converge.
nodes.reason: A less costly administration and a credible civil settlement help govern the actual postwar territory.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Rapid Transformation
nodes.description: Rapid socialist transformation offers a clear political direction for the newly integrated economy. Its pace risks disruption where existing production and distribution cannot adjust.
nodes.reason: The state-enterprise route develops a higher and faster-reached industrial production ceiling.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Gradual Transition
nodes.description: A gradual transition can preserve working enterprises and local knowledge. It asks the revolutionary leadership to tolerate arrangements that do not yet match its final objectives.
nodes.reason: A gradual route keeps productive households and social cooperation available during integration.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Collective Mastery
nodes.description: Collective mastery places organised labour and state institutions at the centre of production. Making it effective requires more than slogans and additional administrative offices.
nodes.reason: Management education and an industrial research grant turn collective ownership into practical production capability.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Household Incentives
nodes.description: Household incentives can relieve pressure on food production without abandoning the socialist state. Such flexibility tests the authority of officials accustomed to uniform targets.
nodes.reason: Household production contributes meaningful food output without abandoning wider state coordination.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Socialist Unity
nodes.description: A unified socialist state must demonstrate that victory can become a sustainable civil order. Its social commitments will remain a claim on national resources.
nodes.reason: The capstone combines a continuing administrative saving with one useful industrial research opportunity.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Reassess the Plan
nodes.description: Truong Chinh's authority rests on long service and the power of political doctrine. The plan must now be examined against the conditions it has actually produced.
nodes.reason: A serious planning review provides usable industrial knowledge immediately rather than paying only for permission to hold a meeting.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Planning Discipline
nodes.description: Planning failures can be answered with firmer discipline and clearer obligations. That approach preserves central authority while narrowing the room for local initiative.
nodes.reason: Reliable purchasing and delivery help agriculture and existing factories without pretending that party planning excludes expertise.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Evidence before Dogma
nodes.description: Economic evidence should be permitted to challenge established formulas. Send officials to learn why production and distribution fall short of their instructions.
nodes.reason: A pilot-led route improves actual project delivery and the conversion of experiments into production practice.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Procurement Targets
nodes.description: Binding procurement targets offer the state more predictable deliveries. They can also weaken the incentive to produce beyond what households need for themselves.
nodes.reason: Food procurement becomes productive and administratively cheaper rather than merely imposing a larger target.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Provincial Inquiries
nodes.description: A provincial inquiry must listen to producers rather than merely confirm reports already written in Hanoi. Its findings may reveal useful experiments and uncomfortable failures.
nodes.reason: Local findings yield production improvements and a concrete construction-research grant.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Congress Documents
nodes.description: The congress documents must acknowledge the gap between intention and result. Prepare a reassessment that can give national renovation an intellectual and political foundation.
nodes.reason: Comparable accounts and technical documentation support government delivery and research collaboration.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Retain the Subsidies
nodes.description: State subsidies protect expectations built over many years. Preserving them can cushion insecurity while committing the budget to continuing support.
nodes.reason: A funded consumption floor protects food production and cooperation during reform.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Enterprise Autonomy
nodes.description: Enterprise managers cannot be held responsible for results if every practical choice requires distant approval. Grant more autonomy and accept the uncertainty of restructuring.
nodes.reason: Retained operational authority offers substantial efficiency growth and a higher production ceiling.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Ration Guarantees
nodes.description: Ration entitlements are a promise between the state and households under strain. Defending that promise must not conceal the weaknesses of the supply system behind it.
nodes.reason: Reliable distribution helps both households and the army instead of offering an abstract stability point.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Selective Price Reform
nodes.description: Selective price changes can reduce distortions without attempting every reform at once. Households and enterprises will still face a difficult adjustment.
nodes.reason: Selective price reform rewards productive firms while retaining the actual stabilisation decision.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Party Rectification
nodes.description: Rectification should uncover administrative failure as well as punish misconduct. Honest review threatens networks that have learned to protect themselves.
nodes.reason: Cadre review cuts administrative waste and gets agreed projects delivered.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Ideological Guardians
nodes.description: Ideological guardianship can preserve a common political direction. It risks turning a necessary reassessment into another exercise in obedience.
nodes.reason: A district-focused party education budget makes nationwide policy easier to carry out.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Prepare Renovation
nodes.description: Renovation requires permission to reconsider policies once presented as settled doctrine. Build that permission into the preparations for the next national programme.
nodes.reason: Party-based technical economists improve research connections and enterprise planning.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Party Schools
nodes.description: District officials must be able to turn a national programme into budgets, supplies and working enterprises. Assign the next training allocation to practical administration and industrial management in the Party school network, while the specialist advisory staff receives no matching expansion.
nodes.reason: Party schools train managers, administrators and technical cadres: lower bureaucracy and stronger delivery are the practical prize.
nodes.lifetime: Parteigebundene Institution über die reguläre Nachfolge hinweg

nodes.label: Hear the Economists
nodes.description: The plan needs a specialist staff able to trace shortages through accounts, transport and prices. Assign the next training allocation to an economic and technical review team, while district Party schools continue without an equivalent expansion.
nodes.reason: Economist consultation produces an equally desirable industrial ceiling, output package and electronics-research opportunity.
nodes.lifetime: Parteigebundene Institution über die reguläre Nachfolge hinweg

nodes.label: An Orderly Handover
nodes.description: A handover can preserve continuity without denying the need for a new programme. Consult the existing leadership institutions and prepare an orderly succession.
nodes.reason: The outgoing team hands over useful administrative records and technical relationships rather than another small power modifier.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Party Led Renovation
nodes.description: Nguyen Van Linh presents renovation as a task of the Party itself. Economic change must confront entrenched interests without dissolving the authority expected to carry it through.
nodes.reason: The opening programme improves existing industry and grants a real industrial research opportunity.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Household Production
nodes.description: Direct the next agrarian renovation allocation towards household delivery contracts, accountable purchasing and the right to retain additional surplus. Cooperatives may still provide services, but this programme puts the new administrative effort behind household responsibility.
nodes.reason: Households deliver a strong food-productivity gain and a more responsive supply economy.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Collective Production
nodes.description: Direct the next agrarian renovation allocation towards shared equipment, technical staff and cooperative infrastructure. Household production continues, but the new funding strengthens common services and collective management rather than enlarging the household contract programme.
nodes.reason: Cooperatives combine food output with shared reconstruction and service capacity.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Expand Rural Trade
nodes.description: Expand the circulation of rural goods so that a productive harvest can reach buyers. Wider commodity trade also exposes households to movements in the market.

before.text: 4% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

nodes.reason: Market access funds a useful industrial learning step and productive local workshops.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Tools and Credit
nodes.description: Tools, credit and shared equipment can make cooperative reform tangible. Their provision is a continuing commitment rather than a substitute for better incentives.
nodes.reason: Tools and credit raise agricultural output and the ability to use existing productive capacity.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Enterprise Accounts
nodes.description: State enterprises need accounts that reveal costs and responsibilities. Begin separating an enterprise's productive performance from its access to political protection.
nodes.reason: Firm-level accountability produces a real, continuing efficiency benefit.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Sequence Price Reform
nodes.description: Price reform can be sequenced so that institutions have time to adjust. A slower transition places a heavier burden on coordination and supervision.
nodes.reason: A managed transition preserves consent and the technical capability to keep reforming.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: End Blanket Subsidies
nodes.description: Blanket subsidies can no longer be treated as an unlimited promise. Their abrupt removal will expose enterprises and households to a painful transition.
nodes.reason: A faster adjustment releases military-industrial output and efficiency headroom at a modest cohesion cost.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: A Consumption Floor
nodes.description: Renovation needs a floor beneath those least able to absorb its costs. Protect basic consumption even where doing so slows fiscal adjustment.
nodes.reason: A credible budgeted guarantee protects the social legitimacy needed for the next reform stage.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Fiscal Stabilisation
nodes.description: Expansion without fiscal restraint risks reproducing the instability reform was meant to address. Accept a period of tighter spending and slower growth while restoring order.
nodes.reason: Better accounts save administration and restore productive operating decisions.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Necessary Action Now
nodes.description: Public criticism of abuse must reach beyond ceremonial self criticism. Expose practices that obstruct reform, even when influential cadres would prefer silence.
nodes.reason: Public criticism supports less protected bureaucracy and faster circulation of technical information.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Party Monopoly
nodes.description: Economic renovation can proceed under a continued Party monopoly. Preserve that political boundary while changing the way the economy is managed.
nodes.reason: The disciplined implementation route gains substantial production performance without pretending political uniformity is a research policy. Capital-policy training remains independent of the constitutional choice.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Political Pluralism
nodes.description: Independent political organisation goes beyond consultation through the Front. Negotiate a new boundary of authority and accept a more fundamental challenge to the existing order.
nodes.reason: Independent scrutiny and expert association offer a genuinely different research and administrative package. Capital-policy training remains independent of the constitutional choice.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Screen Foreign Capital
nodes.description: Screen projects against the machinery, repairs and operating needs of domestic enterprises. Investment can proceed under continued Party rule; the question is how to use limited administrative capacity, not whether political pluralism is required for foreign capital.

before.text: 4% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

nodes.reason: A selective opening develops local industrial output and a higher productive ceiling.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Investment Access
nodes.description: Develop predictable approvals, project infrastructure and operating guarantees for investment partnerships. State oversight remains in place, while the programme commits more of the investment administration to supporting wider commercial access.

lines.text: 4% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

before.text: 6% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

nodes.reason: Clear access rules support a strong construction programme and practical enterprise learning.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Renovation in Crisis
nodes.description: The socialist world cannot be assumed to remain a permanent source of support. Adapt renovation to a future in which Vietnam must rely on a wider range of economic relationships.
nodes.reason: The programme retains project delivery and research connections when old patron arrangements change.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Experiment First
nodes.description: Vo Van Kiet's proposed national mandate puts practical administration ahead of rigid procedure. Begin with experiments that can demonstrate how production and distribution might work better.
nodes.reason: An implementation-focused opening immediately improves projects and existing production.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Provincial Initiative
nodes.description: Provincial initiative can solve problems before a national rule is ready. It also reduces the centre's control over the path of reform.
nodes.reason: Local discretion means cheaper administration and faster delivery, not simply decentralisation as a label.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: A National Pilot
nodes.description: A coordinated national pilot can produce more comparable results. It requires a stronger apparatus to select projects, supervise them and evaluate their progress.
nodes.reason: The alternative coordinates major links and infrastructure across provincial boundaries.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Goods for the Cities
nodes.description: Food and manufactured goods must be able to move from producers to the cities. Remove practical obstacles without pretending that wider circulation is free of market risk.

before.text: 4% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

nodes.reason: A practical distribution network strengthens food production and the use of industrial capacity.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Project Delivery
nodes.description: Give priority projects an office responsible for delivery rather than another set of targets. Coordination itself must remain accountable for the resources it uses.
nodes.reason: Qualified managers make committed projects administratively cheaper and productive operations less wasteful.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Power for Workshops
nodes.description: Reliable electricity determines whether workshops can make use of their labour and machinery. Prepare a period appropriate power project for the northern economy.

lines.text: Start construction of Fossil power plant in state 523

before.text: Start construction of Fossil power plant in state 523

nodes.reason: The paid, queued power plant is the substantive reward; no instant building or artificial percentage is added.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Retained Earnings
nodes.description: Allow enterprises to reinvest a larger share of operating earnings and remove unnecessary central processing. Their investment programme can move faster, but current tax receipts fall as more resources remain inside the firms.
nodes.reason: Retained earnings fund faster enterprise investment and reduce central processing, at the cost of current corporate-tax collection.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Priority Projects
nodes.description: Pool the next development allocation in the national treasury for coordinated infrastructure and priority works. Central direction can connect projects that individual enterprises cannot finance, at the expense of additional administration.
nodes.reason: The public-project route can deliver a stronger transport and construction backbone.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Local Supplier Networks
nodes.description: Local suppliers can reduce delays and connect workshops to a wider productive network. Give their development a place in the construction programme.

lines.text: Start construction of Civilian complex in state 522

before.text: Start construction of Civilian complex in state 522

nodes.reason: A real funded industrial-complex queue develops the supplier network without a free instant plant.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Northern Road Spine
nodes.description: A working road spine binds production to distribution. Organise the recovery of northern links that have become an obstacle to everyday economic life.

lines.text: Start construction of Infrastructure in state 523

before.text: Start construction of Infrastructure in state 523

nodes.reason: Actual queued infrastructure is the useful reward and still consumes native time and construction capacity.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Named Responsibility
nodes.description: Responsibility should remain attached to a named office when a project fails. Auditing delivery challenges administrative practices that benefit from ambiguity.
nodes.reason: Responsibility saves public administration and stops productive capacity being trapped below its potential.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Export Experiments
nodes.description: Small export experiments can test how Vietnamese producers meet outside demand. They also bring international fluctuations closer to the domestic economy.

lines.text: 4% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

before.text: 6% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

nodes.reason: The export route develops industrial output and technical learning without automatically creating an export treaty.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Domestic Supply Chains
nodes.description: A domestic supply chain offers resilience where imports are uncertain. Building it may require accepting a slower route to more efficient production.
nodes.reason: The domestic alternative offers a stronger operating-efficiency base and less dependence on external sales.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Train the Managers
nodes.description: Managers and technicians need opportunities to learn beyond the routines of command allocation. Invest in the skills required to operate the new productive arrangements.
nodes.reason: A meaningful research grant and sustained technical-learning benefit reward management education.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Spare Parts Workshops
nodes.description: A machine awaiting a minor imported component is a factory unable to work. Support local repair and spare parts workshops where domestic production is practical.
nodes.reason: The alternative improves productive output and practical repair capacity instead of duplicating management education.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: Results before Targets
nodes.description: The plan should be judged by what reaches households and workshops. Keep the gains of successful experiments while funding the services needed to sustain them.
nodes.reason: The capstone leaves a strong delivery service and a continuing technical-learning network.
nodes.lifetime: Aktiv bei genau dieser Führung und Partei

nodes.label: A Real Front Mandate
nodes.description: An autonomous Fatherland Front government would require a new political settlement. Give its constituent organisations a real mandate rather than treating their consultation as an endorsement already secured.
nodes.reason: A genuine Front mandate begins with usable administrative coordination and consent.

nodes.label: Workplace Councils
nodes.description: Give elected workplace representatives the leading role in allocating the next industrial management programme. Their knowledge can improve cooperation and civilian production, while consultation requires more administrative work. Technical specialists retain their ordinary advisory roles.
nodes.reason: Worker participation improves the use of existing capacity and social cooperation.

nodes.label: A Technical Cabinet
nodes.description: Give the next industrial management allocation to a specialist technical cabinet and its project staff. Construction and technical review can move more quickly, while maintaining qualified personnel requires a larger education commitment. Workplace representation remains part of ordinary administration.
nodes.reason: A technical alternative brings practical research access and the ability to deliver projects.

nodes.label: Recallable Delegates
nodes.description: Delegates who can be recalled must answer more frequently to their communities. That responsiveness changes the relationship between local representatives and the executive.
nodes.reason: Recallable local representation combines lower bureaucracy with a concrete construction-learning opportunity.

nodes.label: Publish the Accounts
nodes.description: Public accounts make it harder to conceal the cost of a policy. Publication also exposes the government to challenges that closed administration can avoid.
nodes.reason: Transparent accounts reduce administrative waste and reveal avoidable production bottlenecks.

nodes.label: An Agrarian Compact
nodes.description: The rural economy needs a compact that producers can regard as legitimate. Negotiate the relationship between procurement, household effort and public support.
nodes.reason: The coalition's land settlement has a real food-productivity dividend and opens its existing farm-contract programme.

nodes.label: Voluntary Cooperatives
nodes.description: Cooperative federations can pool resources without imposing one organisation on every village. Voluntary coordination demands patient administration.
nodes.reason: Shared services deliver both productive agriculture and useful construction capability.

nodes.label: Family Holdings
nodes.description: Protected family holdings offer households greater security over their work. They narrow the space for officials to treat all rural activity as a planning instruction.
nodes.reason: The household route offers a larger food gain and responsive small-scale production.

nodes.label: Village Clinics
nodes.description: Village clinics turn a promise of social citizenship into a service people can use. Maintaining them requires staff, supplies and a recurring public commitment.
nodes.reason: A funded service network supports public trust and technical capacity rather than merely changing a welfare label.

nodes.label: Small Producer Credit
nodes.description: Small producers often lack the working capital to make use of their skills. Provide access to credit while accepting the task of supervising it responsibly.
nodes.reason: The alternative delivers meaningful construction and operating-efficiency improvements.

nodes.label: Socialist Independence
nodes.description: Independent socialism needs productive competence as well as diplomatic declarations. Establish an industrial adaptation service for machinery and technical manuals, and connect it to a homeland defence programme that can function without surrendering control to a patron.
nodes.reason: Domestic industrial learning and core defence make autonomy materially useful without forcing a diplomatic alignment.

nodes.label: Reconcile the Left
nodes.description: The socialist tradition contains voices that the existing order has excluded. Seek reconciliation with dissenters while accepting the political uncertainty of their return.
nodes.reason: Reconciliation improves administration and cooperation while preserving the native amnesty programme.

nodes.label: A Unified Vanguard
nodes.description: The Front can instead become a unified vanguard in its own right. Concentrating authority may preserve direction while limiting independent criticism.
nodes.reason: The unified alternative provides production discipline and mobilisation consent.

nodes.label: Believers as Citizens
nodes.description: Religious belief should not place a citizen outside the national compact. Translate accommodation into equal treatment by local institutions.
nodes.reason: Equal access broadens the scientific and administrative workforce rather than offering religious favouritism.

nodes.label: Common Cadre Service
nodes.description: A common cadre service can hold the Front's different organisations together. Its scope must be supported by the administrative resources it demands.
nodes.reason: A practical training budget produces better project and enterprise implementation.

nodes.label: A National Compact
nodes.description: A socialist national compact must reconcile participation with the obligations of government. Its stability depends on sustaining the services promised in its name.
nodes.reason: The capstone leaves a lower-cost administration with real delivery capacity.

nodes.label: A Constitutional Pact
nodes.description: An independent Democratic Party government would break with its historical role inside the communist led Front. Build a constitutional compact capable of giving that change a legitimate foundation.
nodes.reason: The pact begins with professional administration and a usable scientific civil service.

nodes.label: Independent Courts
nodes.description: Courts must be able to judge the use of public power without awaiting political permission. Independence requires institutions that can withstand pressure from the executive.
nodes.reason: Reliable courts reduce waste and improve productive contracting rather than providing only abstract legitimacy.

nodes.label: Emergency Executive
nodes.description: An emergency executive offers a more concentrated response to disorder. Its powers place the promised constitutional settlement under strain from the beginning.
nodes.reason: The emergency alternative offers rapid project delivery and a coordinated defence administration.

nodes.label: Speech and Association
nodes.description: Protect civic and professional associations so that citizens can organise, challenge waste and contribute to legislation. Their capacity strengthens constitutional government and public oversight, rather than turning political liberty into a substitute for laboratories or equipment.
nodes.reason: Organised professional and civic associations improve legislative capacity and public oversight. Legal freedom does not create an unexplained electronics research grant.

nodes.label: A Limited Emergency
nodes.description: Emergency powers need a defined purpose and a credible review. Without limits, temporary authority can become the normal condition of the republic.
nodes.reason: A bounded emergency can maintain order and core defence without becoming an unlimited dictatorship.

nodes.label: A Mixed Economy
nodes.description: Neither unrestricted private control nor comprehensive command offers an easy answer to recovery. Negotiate a mixed economy with public obligations and room for enterprise.
nodes.reason: Transparent operating accounts raise both the speed and ceiling of productive efficiency.

nodes.label: Open Public Tenders
nodes.description: Open tenders can make public contracts answer to more than political connections. Transparency also removes instruments on which an executive may have relied.
nodes.reason: Open tenders improve delivery and reduce procurement administration.

nodes.label: National Enterprises
nodes.description: National enterprises can preserve domestic control over important production. Protecting them may come at the expense of wider economic efficiency.
nodes.reason: The alternative offers substantial industrial output and a higher production ceiling.

nodes.label: Small Business Rights
nodes.description: Small firms need secure rights before they can plan beyond immediate survival. Establish a legal framework capable of protecting those rights consistently.
nodes.reason: A strong small-enterprise network improves practical construction and production performance.

nodes.label: A Technical College
nodes.description: A public technical college can widen access to the skills reconstruction requires. It will need a reliable education budget as well as buildings and instructors.
nodes.reason: The alternative grants valuable industrial research and continuing technical-learning capacity.

nodes.label: Reconcile the Citizens
nodes.description: Citizens with different wartime loyalties must be able to live under the same civil order. Reconciliation cannot depend on permanent exclusion from public life.
nodes.reason: Citizenship and reconciliation recover useful administrative competence and public cooperation.

nodes.label: Western Guarantees
nodes.description: Western guarantees might strengthen the government's international position. They also raise difficult questions about dependence and the conditions attached to outside support.

lines.text: 3% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

before.text: 7% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

nodes.reason: A funded diplomatic approach offers technical learning without manufacturing an automatic guarantee or alliance.

nodes.label: Armed Neutrality
nodes.description: Constitutional government need not commit the republic to a strategic camp. A policy of armed neutrality demands a credible domestic basis for independence.
nodes.reason: The alternative gains economical homeland defence and doctrinal preparation without requiring a foreign patron.

nodes.label: Trade before Alignment
nodes.description: Trade can develop before a final strategic alignment is settled. Make practical economic contact possible without promising that outside governments will agree to every request.

before.text: 4% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

nodes.reason: Trade readiness improves real enterprise performance before any actual foreign agreement is assumed.

nodes.label: A Civilian Coalition
nodes.description: A broad civilian coalition can protect constitutional government from a narrow factional contest. Its compromises will make executive decisions slower and more contested.
nodes.reason: The neutral coalition route gains a cheaper, more trusted administration.

nodes.label: Government by Consent
nodes.description: Government by consent depends on rules that remain credible when the incumbent loses. Negotiate guarantees that make peaceful political competition possible.
nodes.reason: A credible electoral settlement preserves competent government across political turnover and retains its existing guarantee decisions.

nodes.label: Socialism by Consent
nodes.description: The northern Socialist Party would need a new mandate to govern independently of the Front's historical arrangements. Base that mandate on consent, public service and the rights of organised labour.
nodes.reason: Socialism by consent starts with reliable food production and cooperation, not an isolated popularity gift.

nodes.label: Independent Unions
nodes.description: Independent unions can speak for workers beyond the priorities of a ministry or enterprise director. Their bargaining strength may challenge established production arrangements.
nodes.reason: Worker participation develops productive efficiency with a modest real social-programme commitment.

nodes.label: A Production Pact
nodes.description: A pact between labour, management and the state can coordinate recovery. It requires institutions capable of mediating interests that do not naturally coincide.
nodes.reason: The alternative directly rewards industrial output and coordinated enterprise operation.

nodes.label: Collective Bargaining
nodes.description: Collective bargaining gives working conditions a place at the negotiating table. The process can protect social peace while slowing some adjustments in production.
nodes.reason: A durable labour bargain supports factories and project delivery rather than only temporary wage calm.

nodes.label: Labour Arbitration
nodes.description: Public arbitration offers a way to resolve labour disputes without suppressing them. A fair system requires expertise, time and a trusted administration.
nodes.reason: The alternative saves administrative resources and restores productive operating time.

nodes.label: Science in Public Life
nodes.description: Scientists and teachers belong at the centre of public reconstruction. Give their institutions resources adequate to the ambitions placed upon them.
nodes.reason: Scientific public service receives a concrete electronics-research grant and a continuing research dividend.

nodes.label: Basic Services for All
nodes.description: Universal basic services can give social citizenship a meaning beyond income. Their continuing cost must be carried honestly in the public budget.
nodes.reason: Universal provision purchases a broad legitimacy and scientific-capacity gain at a visible expenditure commitment.

nodes.label: Target Rural Poverty
nodes.description: Targeted provision can reach the poorest districts with fewer resources. It asks the state to identify needs and maintain access without turning assistance into patronage.
nodes.reason: The alternative reaches food production and rural delivery more strongly with a narrower funding burden.

nodes.label: Housing Cooperatives
nodes.description: Housing cooperatives can combine public support with the organisation of residents. Their work remains a long term responsibility rather than a single construction announcement.
nodes.reason: Construction learning and a strong delivery dividend make housing institutions materially useful.

nodes.label: Health and Literacy
nodes.description: Rural health and literacy can widen the social foundations of recovery. Fund the local institutions that must deliver them through difficult conditions.
nodes.reason: Healthy, educated rural producers add both food productivity and technical-learning capacity.

nodes.label: A Social Budget
nodes.description: A social budget should show both the promises of government and the means available to honour them. Expose waste without hiding the real cost of public services.
nodes.reason: Better public accounts reduce the cost of administration and get funded services built.

nodes.label: Public Key Industries
nodes.description: Public ownership can preserve control over industries considered essential to national development. It does not remove the problems of management and productive efficiency.
nodes.reason: Public ownership receives a large industrial-output package backed by an actual management-training commitment.

nodes.label: A Cooperative Economy
nodes.description: A cooperative mixed economy can combine social ownership with a wider range of initiative. Its diversity requires a more capable framework of coordination.

lines.text: 2.5% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

nodes.reason: The alternative offers a stronger operating-efficiency route without requiring comprehensive public ownership.

nodes.label: Planning Boards
nodes.description: Planning boards can bring elected representatives and producers into economic decisions. Their legitimacy depends on doing useful work rather than multiplying offices.
nodes.reason: Planning boards coordinate capital programmes and productive capacity rather than merely generating political influence.

nodes.label: Firms and Cooperatives
nodes.description: Small firms can coexist with cooperatives where their different strengths meet real demand. Wider exchange will also transmit more movement from the market.

before.text: 4% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

nodes.reason: The mixed route gains continuing technical learning and a faster productive adjustment.

nodes.label: A Social Settlement
nodes.description: A parliamentary social settlement must allow disagreement without abandoning public obligations. Its durability will be measured by how those obligations survive a change of government.
nodes.reason: A credible settlement sustains public cooperation and a lower-cost administration while preserving native electoral guarantees.

nodes.label: A Republican Mandate
nodes.description: A VNQDD return to Hanoi would require a profound political rupture or a negotiated return from exile. Seek a republican mandate without pretending that nationalist factions have already become one movement.
nodes.reason: A VNQDD-led alternate mandate begins with homeland resilience and civil cooperation.

nodes.label: Constitutional Rule
nodes.description: The constitution should bind the president as firmly as it binds a political opponent. Establish legal limits that cannot be removed whenever the executive finds them inconvenient.
nodes.reason: Professional administration and technical freedom make the constitutional option practically attractive.

nodes.label: A Strong Presidency
nodes.description: A strong presidency can impose direction on a divided nationalist coalition. That concentration of authority risks weakening the civil institutions the republic claims to defend.
nodes.reason: The alternative gives fast delivery and stronger mobilisation consent without claiming an automatic party victory.

nodes.label: National Reconciliation
nodes.description: National reconciliation requires terms on which former opponents can return to civil life. Offer conditional protection without erasing the memory of the conflict.
nodes.reason: Reconciliation restores cooperation and useful productive experience.

nodes.label: Integrate the Factions
nodes.description: Rival armed factions cannot indefinitely remain governments within the government. Bring their integration under common authority while accepting the instability of the process.
nodes.reason: The presidential alternative offers real military cohesion and core defence, not invented new divisions.

nodes.label: Peasant Smallholdings
nodes.description: Secure peasant holdings can give the republic a stronger rural foundation. A practical system of titles and dispute resolution must support that promise.
nodes.reason: A clear land compact has a substantial food-productivity prize and keeps its existing farm-contract decision.

nodes.label: Protect Local Industry
nodes.description: Protection can help domestic industry survive uncertain conditions. It can also shelter inefficient production and restrict access to more competitive suppliers.
nodes.reason: Selective industrial protection rewards output and practical operating experience.

nodes.label: A Commercial Republic
nodes.description: A commercial republic would place more of recovery in the circulation of goods and enterprise. Its opportunities will depend increasingly on conditions beyond national control.

lines.text: 3% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

before.text: 6% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

nodes.reason: The commercial alternative develops construction and the productive ceiling instead of a generic growth variable.

nodes.label: A National Arsenal
nodes.description: A national arsenal can reduce dependence on foreign military supply. Preparing its construction commits scarce capital to defence rather than civilian recovery.

lines.text: Start construction of Military factory in state 524

before.text: Start construction of Military factory in state 524

nodes.reason: A real queued arms factory is the reward; it still needs native construction capacity and time.

nodes.label: Haiphong Trading House
nodes.description: Haiphong can serve as a centre for legitimate trade and commercial administration. Organise the institutions and construction required to make that role productive.

lines.text: Start construction of offices in state 522

before.text: Start construction of offices in state 522

nodes.reason: The actual funded office project develops commercial capacity without pretending to grant a port or instant international market access.

nodes.label: Equal Citizenship
nodes.description: Religion, region and former allegiance must not determine who belongs to the republic. Turn the language of national unity into equal civil treatment.
nodes.reason: Equal access restores cooperation and administrative competence across religious communities.

nodes.label: No Foreign Tutelage
nodes.description: Independence should not become a change from one foreign patron to another. Preserve room for national decision even where doing so limits easier economic opportunities.
nodes.reason: The autonomous route receives economical homeland defence rather than an empty refusal of foreign aid.

nodes.label: External Guarantees
nodes.description: External guarantees can support a vulnerable republic. Negotiate their terms rather than assuming that outside powers share every Vietnamese objective.

lines.text: 3% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

before.text: 5% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

nodes.reason: The alternative develops domestic technical and reconstruction capacity while actual guarantees still require consent.

nodes.label: Citizen Defence
nodes.description: Citizen defence can connect sovereignty to a wider social responsibility. It also draws time and resources away from civil reconstruction.
nodes.reason: The autonomous route gains experienced instructors, faster real training and better core defence.

nodes.label: Trade for Development
nodes.description: Trade offers a route to development that military mobilisation cannot supply. Give commercial administration a stable place in national policy.
nodes.reason: The partnership route turns commercial exchange into productive efficiency and technical learning.

nodes.label: Beyond Faction
nodes.description: The republic must become more durable than the coalition that brought it to power. Seek institutions capable of surviving factional defeat without another rupture.
nodes.reason: The capstone improves administrative efficiency and the productive ceiling while preserving actual election guarantees.

nodes.label: The Military Council
nodes.description: A provisional military council would replace the historical relationship between Party and army with a new concentration of power. Its first decisions must determine what the emergency is meant to achieve.
nodes.reason: A provisional council begins with real military cohesion and mobilisation consent.

nodes.label: Service before Faction
nodes.description: Professional service can offer a common standard where factions compete for influence. Its credibility depends on institutions that reward competence rather than loyalty alone.
nodes.reason: The professional route trains forces faster and coordinates them better through a real education commitment.

nodes.label: Security Directorate
nodes.description: A security directorate offers the council a firmer grip on opposition and administration. It also threatens the independent knowledge on which sound policy depends.
nodes.reason: The security route materially strengthens economical homeland defence at a limited civic-cohesion cost.

nodes.label: Officer Standards
nodes.description: Officer standards should demand preparation as well as obedience. More professional training requires time that cannot also be spent on immediate expansion.
nodes.reason: Officer education provides a substantial experience grant and a cheaper doctrinal lesson rather than another generic modifier.

nodes.label: Screen the Cadres
nodes.description: Screening the civil service can remove rivals but also deprive the state of experience. Recovery will suffer if political suspicion becomes a substitute for administration.
nodes.reason: A focused review improves command cohesion and productive organisation without creating units or scripting a universal purge.

nodes.label: Civilian Nationalists
nodes.description: Civilian nationalists can supply expertise and a connection to political traditions outside the officer corps. Bringing them in will make the council's decisions more contested.
nodes.reason: Civilian expertise makes public delivery cheaper and more capable while the transition programme remains native.

nodes.label: Defence Industry First
nodes.description: Defence industry can support the council's promise of security. Farms and the civilian economy will bear the opportunity cost of that priority.
nodes.reason: The military-production route offers a large output and arms-construction package.

nodes.label: Civil Recovery First
nodes.description: Civil recovery offers a different basis for military legitimacy. Put reconstruction ahead of a rapid expansion in weapons production.
nodes.reason: The alternative is equally useful through strong construction and food production.

nodes.label: A Military Workshop
nodes.description: A dispersed military workshop can provide a more reliable repair and production base. Its construction must still be supported by the resources of the economy.

lines.text: Start construction of Military factory in state 524

before.text: Start construction of Military factory in state 524

nodes.reason: Its real queued arms factory is enough to be desirable without an artificial free building or duplicate stat.

nodes.label: Public Works and Peace
nodes.description: Demobilisation can return labour to civilian life and make public works possible. It also reduces the manpower held ready for military service.
nodes.reason: Public works protect food production and civil cooperation instead of simply rewarding a military government for remaining in power.

nodes.label: Audit Military Firms
nodes.description: Military enterprises should not be exempt from public accounting. Auditing them will challenge interests close to the council itself.
nodes.reason: An actual audit saves administration and improves the use of productive capacity.

nodes.label: A Permanent Council
nodes.description: A permanent council would turn emergency authority into a governing institution. It must accept the long term political and intellectual costs of that choice.
nodes.reason: The permanent route has real military value, with a visible continuing administrative burden.

nodes.label: Civilian Transition
nodes.description: A civilian transition needs a process that the armed forces cannot quietly reverse. Set the terms of a handover through negotiations with credible civilian representatives.
nodes.reason: The transition route develops civilian delivery and scientific administration rather than being the deliberately weak alternative.

nodes.label: Armed Neutrality
nodes.description: Armed neutrality promises to defend sovereignty without another patron's direction. Maintaining that posture can narrow the resources available for development.
nodes.reason: A self-reliant council gets cheaper sustainment, core defence and a finite doctrinal improvement.

nodes.label: Constituent Assembly
nodes.description: A constituent assembly can give the next civil order a public foundation. Its disagreements are part of the transition rather than proof that transition has failed.
nodes.reason: The civilian route recovers a strong professional administration, scientific capacity and consent.

nodes.label: A Regular Mandate
nodes.description: The provisional mandate must either become a defined institution or give way to a civilian order. End the uncertainty over who is entitled to govern and under which rules.
nodes.reason: A defined mandate leaves useful productive standards and a trained service cadre rather than another small power coupon.

nodes.label: Rehabilitate Hanoi Workshops
nodes.description: Bombing and interrupted supply have left workshops idle. Restore a working civilian production centre in Hanoi, put its machinery back into use and establish the base from which wider reconstruction can proceed.

lines.text: Improve War Damage to recovery stage 1

before.text: Improve War Damage to recovery stage 1

nodes.reason: Rehabilitation delivers the first real civilian workshop and reduces the war-damage spirit.

nodes.label: Disperse Workshops
nodes.description: Dispersed workshops are harder to neutralise in one attack. They also sacrifice some of the efficiency of production concentrated around a common infrastructure.
nodes.reason: Dispersed workshops survive bombing and can be repaired quickly.

nodes.label: Restore the Centres
nodes.description: Industrial centres can bring labour, power and transport back into closer coordination. Concentration creates its own vulnerabilities and demands reliable supply.
nodes.reason: Concentrated industrial centres build faster and sustain longer production runs.

nodes.label: Mobile Repair Crews
nodes.description: Mobile crews can repair links that fixed offices are too slow to reach. Their labour must be drawn from other pressing tasks in the civilian economy.
nodes.reason: Mobile crews restore damaged factories and transport without drawing a permanent penalty from farms.

nodes.label: Haiphong Power
nodes.description: Haiphong's productive role depends on usable power as well as access to the sea. Prepare the rehabilitation and construction needed to restore that foundation.

lines.text: Start construction of Fossil power plant in state 522

before.text: Start construction of Fossil power plant in state 522

nodes.reason: The paid power-plant project creates actual generation capacity; it also speeds later utility works.

nodes.label: Reconnect the North
nodes.description: Northern districts cannot recover in isolation from one another. Reconnect the transport links on which production, food distribution and administration depend.

lines.text: Improve War Damage to recovery stage 2
Start construction of Infrastructure in state 524

before.text: Improve War Damage to recovery stage 2
Start construction of Infrastructure in state 524

nodes.reason: The road project improves a physical state and the war-damage recovery stage.

nodes.label: Capital Goods First
nodes.description: Capital goods promise a stronger productive base in the future. Giving them priority asks households to carry a heavier burden in the present.
nodes.reason: Machine-building research and better project execution support investment rather than pretending capital goods are munitions.

nodes.label: Civilian Needs First
nodes.description: Recovery must deliver goods that households need now. Place civilian consumption ahead of some demands for rapid military industrial expansion.
nodes.reason: Civilian production supplies faster investment and cheaper social provision.

nodes.label: Equip the Northern Workshops
nodes.description: The northern workshop network must be able to repair and produce the equipment the army consumes. Equip a military production line within the reconstruction programme while the rest of the country continues to demand scarce machinery.

lines.text: Start construction of Military factory in state 524

before.text: Start construction of Civilian complex in state 524

nodes.reason: The northern workshop network receives a funded armament production line rather than another percentage on zero military capacity.

nodes.label: Expand Civilian Toolmaking
nodes.description: A working workshop is only the beginning. Expand the supply of tools, spare parts and trained supervisors needed by civilian construction, rather than forcing every project to compete for the same imported equipment.

before.text: Start construction of Civilian complex in state 522

nodes.reason: The restored Hanoi workshops now expand tools and civilian construction capacity.

nodes.label: A Technical Workforce
nodes.description: Skilled workers and technicians are as necessary as machinery. Fund the training that allows restored facilities to produce reliably.
nodes.reason: Technicians bring a finite industrial research breakthrough and faster rebuilding.

nodes.label: Domestic Components
nodes.description: Domestic components can make essential production less vulnerable to an interrupted import. Their development may require accepting a slower rise in efficiency.
nodes.reason: Domestic components keep production running through restrictions and missing imports.

nodes.label: Specialist Machinery
nodes.description: Specialist machinery can relieve constraints that domestic workshops cannot yet overcome. Access to it brings both opportunities and greater exposure to international conditions.

lines.text: 5% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

before.text: 5% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

nodes.reason: Specialist imports deliver two industrial research opportunities and faster modernisation.

nodes.label: A Repair Depot
nodes.description: A repair depot can keep scarce equipment useful for longer. Its organisation requires staff, stocks and common technical standards.
nodes.reason: A national repair depot restores industrial capacity and retains usable production techniques.

nodes.label: Engineering Contracts
nodes.description: Engineering contracts can bring knowledge that is difficult to acquire alone. Negotiate practical assistance without assuming that an invitation guarantees a partner.
nodes.reason: Engineering contracts provide construction research and better project execution.

nodes.label: An Industrial Recovery
nodes.description: Recovery has become more than the immediate repair of wartime damage. Consolidate the productive base while recognising the costs that a long conflict has left behind.

lines.text: Improve War Damage to recovery stage 3

before.text: Improve War Damage to recovery stage 3

nodes.reason: The final recovery stage removes the remaining approved war-damage burden and improves normal construction.

nodes.label: Secure the Rice Supply
nodes.description: Food supply is a daily test of national resilience. Review procurement and distribution before a poor harvest or a broken transport link becomes a wider emergency.
nodes.reason: Rice supply administration now raises actual agricultural productivity.

nodes.label: Raise Procurement
nodes.description: Higher collective procurement targets can make deliveries to the state more predictable. They can also weaken incentives where households retain too little of their additional effort.
nodes.reason: Predictable procurement supports ration stability and military distribution.

nodes.label: Expand Plot Incentives
nodes.description: Household plots already have a place beside collective farming. Expand their incentives and productive role rather than treating every useful local practice as a deviation.
nodes.reason: Household surplus incentives deliver a substantially larger harvest.

nodes.label: Irrigation Crews
nodes.description: Irrigation work can make organised rural labour more productive. Prepare a district project that improves the agricultural base rather than merely increasing procurement demands.

lines.text: Start construction of Agricultural district in state 522

before.text: Start construction of Agricultural district in state 522

nodes.reason: Irrigation creates the paid agricultural district and protects subsequent repair work.

nodes.label: Village Market Access
nodes.description: Village producers need a practical route to buyers and supplies. Improve market access while maintaining the administrative work that makes exchange possible.
nodes.reason: Market access improves the taxable rural trading network as well as the harvest.

nodes.label: A Grain Reserve
nodes.description: A grain reserve can cushion distribution when ordinary deliveries fail. Keeping it useful requires supervision, storage and a willingness to bear its cost.
nodes.reason: A reserve system reduces the rationing spirit and emergency social expenditure.

nodes.label: Prioritize Fertiliser and Tools
nodes.description: Allocate the next rural investment programme to fertiliser, tools and repair capacity. Better inputs can raise yields without transferring still more labour into the fields, although imported supplies expose the programme to external disruption.

lines.text: 3% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

before.text: 4% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

nodes.reason: Capital-intensive inputs improve yields and bring a practical industrial research application.

nodes.label: Expand Rural Labour Teams
nodes.description: Allocate the next rural investment programme to organised labour, drainage and local access roads. It can proceed with fewer imported inputs, but the workers assigned to it cannot simultaneously fill the northern workshops.
nodes.reason: Labour-intensive rural teams improve yields and road building without waiting for imported machinery.

nodes.label: Northern Rice Districts
nodes.description: Strengthen northern rice production through a new agricultural district. The project must be planned and built before its capacity can be relied upon.

lines.text: Start construction of Agricultural district in state 523

before.text: Start construction of Agricultural district in state 523

nodes.reason: The second agricultural district is a physical funded expansion of food production.

nodes.label: Dykes and Local Roads
nodes.description: Dykes and local roads protect the connection between the harvest and the population it must feed. Their maintenance is less spectacular than a new industrial target, but no less necessary.

lines.text: Start construction of Infrastructure in state 522

before.text: Start construction of Infrastructure in state 522

nodes.reason: Dykes and roads create the paid infrastructure project and faster flood recovery.

nodes.label: Health and Nutrition
nodes.description: Health and nutrition determine whether rural households can sustain their work. Extend practical provision while recognising its recurring demands on the state.
nodes.reason: Better nutrition and rural services support social stability and recruit health.

nodes.label: Fund Universal Food Support
nodes.description: Use the next food security allocation to protect basic consumption and predictable prices. Broad support cushions households when distribution fails, while its administration must reach far beyond the most productive villages.
nodes.reason: Universal price support provides strong stability and lower emergency welfare pressure.

nodes.label: Fund Household Production Contracts
nodes.description: Use the next food security allocation to reward additional household deliveries. Contracted surplus can rebuild supplies and rural trade, but incomes become more exposed to prices and uneven market access.

lines.text: 2% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

nodes.reason: Production contracts raise output and formal taxable rural trade.

nodes.label: Rural Distribution
nodes.description: A rural distribution service can bring essential goods closer to the people producing the harvest. Its reliability depends on resources as well as instructions.
nodes.reason: Distribution reform removes recurring administrative waste and improves transport.

nodes.label: Market the Surplus
nodes.description: A marketable surplus can improve the prospects of rural producers. The resulting trade also exposes them more directly to changing economic conditions.

before.text: 4% higher World market transmission (booms and crises)

nodes.reason: Marketed surplus improves agricultural returns and develops taxable enterprise.

nodes.label: Food Security
nodes.description: Food security has improved through stronger production and distribution. Some expense and inefficiency will remain even after the worst shortages have been relieved.
nodes.reason: Food security improves the final rationing stage and reduces emergency welfare needs.

nodes.label: Review the People’s War
nodes.description: The People's Army has accumulated experience under exceptional conditions. Review what that experience can teach without assuming that endurance removes the need for organisation and resources.
nodes.reason: The doctrinal review gives experience that can actually be spent and a finite doctrine discount.

nodes.label: Local Defence
nodes.description: Local defence can use knowledge of terrain and dispersed organisation. It offers a different priority from concentrating resources in a larger military industrial effort.
nodes.reason: Territorial institutions provide entrenchment and strong homeland defence.

nodes.label: Combined Arms
nodes.description: Combined arms operations require coordination among forces with different demands. Their effectiveness depends on a supply system able to sustain the concentration.
nodes.reason: Combined-arms organisation improves the main army and offensive preparation.

nodes.label: Redundant Supply Lines
nodes.description: A redundant network can keep supplies moving when one route fails. Building and maintaining it diverts resources from civil construction.
nodes.reason: Redundant routes reduce the army supply burden rather than simply moving a construction penalty.

nodes.label: A General Staff
nodes.description: A professional general staff must turn experience into reliable planning. More demanding preparation will take longer than rapid mobilisation alone.
nodes.reason: A working general staff improves planning and provides usable doctrinal training.

nodes.label: Defend Hanoi
nodes.description: Hanoi and Haiphong require a more coherent air defence network. Prepare additional defensive installations without assuming that hardware can replace trained crews and organisation.

lines.text: Start construction of Anti air battery in state 522

before.text: Start construction of Anti air battery in state 522

nodes.reason: The Hanoi anti-aircraft project is backed by trained air-defence personnel.

nodes.label: An Affordable Army
nodes.description: An affordable army must be matched to the resources the country can sustain. Reduce its demands even where that means holding fewer people ready for service.
nodes.reason: A smaller professional establishment is cheaper to supply and better organised.

nodes.label: Mobilisation Reserves
nodes.description: Large mobilisation reserves preserve a capacity for prolonged war. Farms and rural households must live with the labour those reserves absorb.
nodes.reason: A genuine reserve provides more available manpower and faster training.

nodes.label: Repair before Replace
nodes.description: Repair can keep scarce military equipment in use. Concentrating on existing systems also limits the resources available to investigate new ones.
nodes.reason: Refurbishment gives an infantry research opportunity and more efficient production.

nodes.label: Train Reserve Cadres
nodes.description: Reserve cadres need training that can be repeated and passed on. The programme consumes time and labour that civilian reconstruction also requires.
nodes.reason: Reserve cadres provide immediate experience and reduce training time.

nodes.label: Coastal Approaches
nodes.description: The coastal approaches connect military security to trade and everyday supply. Organise a sustainable patrol programme suited to the country's resources.
nodes.reason: The common coastal survey trains both services before their specialised programmes.

nodes.label: Coastal Defence
nodes.description: Coastal defence offers practical protection before expensive naval prestige. Such concentration reinforces a more guarded relationship with the outside world.
nodes.reason: Coastal fortification gains entrenchment and manpower-efficient defence.

nodes.label: Small Fleet Repairs
nodes.description: A small fleet needs repair capacity before it can remain reliably at sea. Prepare a dockyard project that the country can sustain.

lines.text: Start construction of Dockyard in state 523

before.text: Start construction of Dockyard in state 523

nodes.reason: The paid dockyard is accompanied by useful naval experience and doctrine development.

nodes.label: Civil Defence Teams
nodes.description: Civil defence and medical teams protect the ability of communities to endure disruption. Their work also requires a continuing social commitment.
nodes.reason: Civil-defence teams improve mobilisation recovery and restore bombed installations.

nodes.label: Aircrew Training
nodes.description: A sustainable air force begins with trained crews and instructors. Give education and maintenance knowledge a place beside demands for additional aircraft.
nodes.reason: Aircrew training gives air experience and a real air-doctrine discount, independent of buying a dockyard.

nodes.label: The Service Settlement
nodes.description: Peace allows service personnel to return to civilian work and family life. Their settlement requires support, and demobilisation relinquishes part of the wartime recruitment advantage.
nodes.reason: The service settlement reduces the mobilisation burden and returns labour to reconstruction.

nodes.label: The Divided Nation
nodes.description: North and South remain separate political orders in a country whose future is contested. Military action, negotiation and the responsibilities of eventual peace must all be considered.
nodes.reason: A common war-and-peace mandate offers cohesion and real operational study.

nodes.label: Concentrate Battlefield Pressure
nodes.description: Concentrate additional staff work and supplies on battlefield pressure. Negotiations remain possible, but this allocation seeks leverage through the army and commits resources that cannot also enlarge the diplomatic effort.
nodes.reason: Concentrated battlefield effort improves organisation and planning.

nodes.label: Strengthen the Negotiating Mandate
nodes.description: Concentrate additional staff and political effort on a credible negotiating position. The armed struggle need not cease, but the delegation must be able to defend specific terms and maintain confidence that a settlement will be honoured.
nodes.reason: A strengthened negotiating mandate improves stability and homeland staying power.

nodes.label: Southern Corridors
nodes.description: The southern corridors must remain usable if military pressure is to be sustained. Their protection competes with the rebuilding of the civil economy.
nodes.reason: Southern corridors lower supply demand and train infrastructure planners.

nodes.label: Terms and Guarantees
nodes.description: Terms and guarantees have value only where the other parties are prepared to accept them. Exchange proposals while preserving a clear account of the responsibilities each government would assume.
nodes.reason: Guarantees improve public confidence and reduce the cost of administering a settlement.

nodes.label: After the Fighting
nodes.description: The end of large scale fighting will not itself create a functioning civil settlement. Prepare the administrative and social work that must follow it.
nodes.reason: Recovery after fighting restores damaged buildings rather than adding another administrative bill.

nodes.label: Unified Administration
nodes.description: Where the southern states are actually under our administration, a common framework can begin. Joining institutions after a long war will produce disruption before it produces coherence.
nodes.reason: Unified administration cuts duplicated offices and expands taxable enterprise.

nodes.label: Peaceful Coexistence
